slashh.settings.title: Slashh Settings
slashh.settings.others.tip: Draw slashes from other players' hits.
slashh.settings.colours.tip: Colour each slash by the damage type of the hit: fire is orange, frost is pale blue, and so on.
slashh.settings.finishers.tip: The last swing of a weapon's combo is a crossed X-cut.
slashh.settings.sweeps.tip: The extra targets of a sweep get a wide flat arc.
slashh.settings.spray.tip: Blood hits and bleed bursts spray droplets.
slashh.settings.classic.tip: Use the old pixel cut instead of the smooth one.
